OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility with the flat form; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence and this value is
            composed from the normalized address lines. On response it holds
            the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; the composed
            'address' is derived from it (and 'addressLine2' when supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present its normalized value is appended to
            'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as
            'YYYY-MM-DD'. When present it is used to derive the owner's age band
            as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time flag. A household is keyed on (last name,
            postcode), so every owner is automatically assigned the household id
            derived from those fields and owners sharing a last name and postcode
            share it. A second owner of an existing household is otherwise
            rejected as a household duplicate (409 Conflict); setting this flag to
            true declares the new owner a member of that household, bypassing the
            duplicate block. A declared member is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned on
                create; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household,
                assigned on create. It is deterministic: the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name
                concatenated with '|' and the postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived value formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where an absent
                email or household id contributes an empty segment. Members of
                the same household share a household id but, having different
                telephones, still have distinct identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                while an existing owner already shared its last name and postcode
                under a different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of — the earliest owner sharing its last name and postcode under a
                different telephone. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when the
                owner has an email, plus 1 when the owner is uniquely named (a
                namesakeCount of 0), plus 2 for a household of three or more,
                plus 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, the band their membershipPoints
                fall into: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or
                more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region the owner belongs to: the REGION segment of
                the owner's customer code, derived from the postcode range first,
                falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves
                a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name mapped from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today
                (by registration date), signalling an unusually high volume of
                sign-ups; false otherwise. Evaluated per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Evaluated per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of the registration date, derived from
                the birth date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility with the flat form; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence and this value is
            composed from the normalized address lines. On response it holds
            the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; the composed
            'address' is derived from it (and 'addressLine2' when supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present its normalized value is appended to
            'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as
            'YYYY-MM-DD'. When present it is used to derive the owner's age band
            as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time flag. A household is keyed on (last name,
            postcode), so every owner is automatically assigned the household id
            derived from those fields and owners sharing a last name and postcode
            share it. A second owner of an existing household is otherwise
            rejected as a household duplicate (409 Conflict); setting this flag to
            true declares the new owner a member of that household, bypassing the
            duplicate block. A declared member is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned on
                create; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household,
                assigned on create. It is deterministic: the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name
                concatenated with '|' and the postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived value formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where an absent
                email or household id contributes an empty segment. Members of
                the same household share a household id but, having different
                telephones, still have distinct identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                while an existing owner already shared its last name and postcode
                under a different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of — the earliest owner sharing its last name and postcode under a
                different telephone. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when the
                owner has an email, plus 1 when the owner is uniquely named (a
                namesakeCount of 0), plus 2 for a household of three or more,
                plus 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, the band their membershipPoints
                fall into: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or
                more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region the owner belongs to: the REGION segment of
                the owner's customer code, derived from the postcode range first,
                falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves
                a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name mapped from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today
                (by registration date), signalling an unusually high volume of
                sign-ups; false otherwise. Evaluated per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Evaluated per response.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band as of the registration date, derived from
                the birth date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, such as 'MR', 'MRS',
            'MS' or 'DR'. When present it is combined with the last name to form
            the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility with the flat form; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence and this value is
            composed from the normalized address lines. On response it holds
            the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; the composed
            'address' is derived from it (and 'addressLine2' when supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present its normalized value is appended to
            'addressLine1', separated by a single space, to form 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this
            E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city: the city's region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) fixes an inclusive range (NSW
            2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that the postcode must fall
            within; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The
            value is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as
            'YYYY-MM-DD'. When present it is used to derive the owner's age band
            as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time flag. A household is keyed on (last name,
            postcode), so every owner is automatically assigned the household id
            derived from those fields and owners sharing a last name and postcode
            share it. A second owner of an existing household is otherwise
            rejected as a household duplicate (409 Conflict); setting this flag to
            true declares the new owner a member of that household, bypassing the
            duplicate block. A declared member is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. This flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner

        - type: object
          properties:

              title: ID

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned on
                create; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household,
                assigned on create. It is deterministic: the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name
                concatenated with '|' and the postcode, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived value formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where an absent
                email or household id contributes an empty segment. Members of
                the same household share a household id but, having different
                telephones, still have distinct identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created
                while an existing owner already shared its last name and postcode
                under a different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of — the earliest owner sharing its last name and postcode under a
                different telephone. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when the
                owner has an email, plus 1 when the owner is uniquely named (a
                namesakeCount of 0), plus 2 for a household of three or more,
                plus 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, the band their membershipPoints
                fall into: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or
                more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region the owner belongs to: the REGION segment of
                the owner's customer code, derived from the postcode range first,
                falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves
                a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name mapped from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today
                (by registration date), signalling an unusually high volume of
                sign-ups; false otherwise. Evaluated per response.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is

              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL

              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I implemented the `salutation` feature following the codebase's existing conventions for owner fields.

**What the change does:** Owners now accept an optional `title` (e.g. `MR`/`MRS`/`MS`/`DR`) on create, and expose a computed read-only `salutation` = `title + ' ' + lastName`, or just `lastName` when no title is given.

**Changes made, each in the layer where it belongs:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** (source of the generated DTOs):
   - Added `title` as an optional editable string on `OwnerFields` (the request/input schema, alongside `firstName`/`lastName`).
   - Added `salutation` as a `readOnly` string on the `Owner` response schema, matching the pattern of the other derived fields (`displayName`, `initials`, …).

2. **`Owner.java`** (domain model):
   - Added the persisted `title` column with a standard getter/setter.
   - Added `getSalutation()` as a `@Transient` derived accessor next to the sibling `getDisplayName()` — a small, single-responsibility method that reuses the inherited `getLastName()`.

3. **Schema DDL** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`): added the `title` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (the test profile uses `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column is required there).

MapStruct wires everything automatically by name: `title` from the DTO into `Owner.setTitle`, and `Owner.getSalutation()` into the response DTO — no mapper edits needed, consistent with how `displayName`/`initials` already work.

`AcceptanceTest.coreComposesSalutation` (title `DR`, lastName `who` → `"DR who"`) and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
